_comment: Page numbers of the Book build the published desk page images (pages/pNNN.jpg) were rendered from. The author region notes in the artifact db are stored against these exact filenames, so these numbers may only change when the JPGs are re-rendered in the same commit. build_figure_desk.py reports the drift against today Book PDF; it never applies it.
renderedFrom: the mega-volume build current when the desk was first published (2026-09-13); see FINDINGS.reconciliation.renderDrift for the offset against the committed PDF
_imported_note: fig-pareto-dominance, fig-sybil-deposit-floor and fig-cartel-folk-theorem are \includegraphics PDFs with no TikZ fragment, so the fragment-driven first cut of the desk never listed them and they have no published region notes. Their render pages are the chapter-7 render offset (-2) applied to the Book pages the pixel judgment measured them on (377, 378, 380); all three JPGs are already published. Re-render and these three are re-derived like any other.
_new_figure_pages: Keys 601/611/621/631 are reserved image slots for new 2026-09-27 figures; each pNNN.jpg is rendered from its true Book page (65/186/187/229), while FIGS[].bookPage records that page. Existing keys and saved region notes are unchanged.
_snapshot_note: snapshots maps immutable review image slots to their true PDF page and source SHA. Old images and region-note filenames remain unchanged; slot numbers are not Book pages.

_provisional_pages.note: Provisional pins for figures new in the plain-language rewrite (2026-11-09). Each pNNN.jpg (slot-1, slot, slot+1) is rendered at 120 dpi from that PR's publication build, not from the accepted Book PDF, which does not contain these figures yet. Re-bind them with refresh_figure_desk_pages.py when Erich accepts the next print.
